Cache hit with OpenDAL memory backend returns cached response on repeat request

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from liter_llm import create_client_from_json
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client_from_json("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"opendal:memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}")
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json('{"messages":[{"content":"Hello","role":"user"}],"model":"openai/gpt-4o"}')
    result = await client.chat(req)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
